### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Harold Kowalczyk received a past-due notice for "the air-conditioning repair ... back in July: the technician replaced a valve on the outdoor unit and recharged it", paid "$250 on your card at the door". He wants "to set up a payment arrangement and make the first payment today on your debit card", does not know what is owed, leaves "the number of payments and the size of the first one to the agent". Authorisation: "If the agent tells you that something has to be added to or taken off the bill before the payment can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead". Identity: phone 6145553271 + PIN 7340. He responds passively (membership/filters/protection plan: "you have all of those"; arrival time only if asked: "early afternoon"). He executes the user-owned payment tool when handed it: "you pay exactly that amount with your debit card, which is a card payment". Target object, timing (today), boundary (first installment of an arrangement) and authorisation (agent may add/remove what is owed) are all clear.

- "Do only what the customer asked" (take the installment on 840.45): excluded by the root's own sentence (installment not taken until the invoice carries the late-payment charge), and the late-payment charge itself cannot be figured while the late-arrival credit and refrigerant allowance owed are missing (two sentences on its hub).
- Closest alternatives excluded by visible text/records: grace 15 or 0 instead of 10 (`arrival_grace…`: Silver = Priority -> 10; changes multiplier 1 vs 1.5); credit base 5 % (unit is protected); comfort-call addition 10 (tier has 0 response hours); tune-up count only on the AC (2) vs all on the agreement (3) — lookback doc counts "completed tune-up visits posted to the member's agreement"; grace 40 (three drafts, not two); period count 2 (payments > 0 but < 25 %); rate 1.25 % (2024-08-31 late fee outside 24 months); installments 3 (balance 575.08 adds 1); up-front including net fees (autopay drafts exist -> late charges alone); call `925ba6ea…` excluded (not past due).
- Fall-back answers (computation doc + product figures only): on-time credit 25.00; refrigerant allowance 0 lb (Silver lists 0) -> no line; late-payment charge 570.80 x 1.5 % x 2 = 17.12; first installment = whole balance 575.08 (one installment, and 575.08 < 750). All definite and different from the derived answers.
- Factor findability (record words that led there): tier "Comfort Club Silver" -> plan schedule "Priority" -> arrival grace doc ("scheduling priority ... with priority"); contract status active + equipment_id = call unit -> credit-base, protection pounds, minimum-balance docs ("Harbison Protection Contracts ... unit each covers"); arrived_at/scheduled_date -> lateness multiplier; symptom no_cool -> comfort-call addition; consecutive_terms -> consecutive-terms pounds, installment count; plan_tuneup_visit completed_visit + enrolled_date -> look-back + maintenance count pounds; subscription "Pleated MERV 11" active -> FilterDirect pounds; install closed_date -> installation pounds; dues ledger ach_autopay entries -> grace and up-front; late_fee entry -> rate; enrolled_date -> relief; payment line vs charge lines -> period count; balance -> added installments. No computation document pointed at a factor.
- Reading tensions noted (not decisive here): the plan doc says "Comfort Club Platinum is the first tier with a refrigerant allowance (1 pound per term)", whereas the service docs say an active member "has a refrigerant allowance on each completed call" and the factor pounds "count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds"; I read Silver as 0 + factor pounds. The rate doc's "last 24 months" carries no counting convention; immaterial here (25 months).
